modes.preserve: Preserve apparent anatomy/body characteristics; changes may come only from pose, clothing, lens, and light.
modes.presentation_only: No anatomy change; permit pose, camera presentation, styling, garment shaping, and posture changes.
modes.creative_transformation: Permit explicitly requested adult body changes without assuming one universal ideal.
modes.plausible_fitness_projection: Permit a realistic, non-guaranteed projection of fitness-related changes while keeping skeletal character plausible.
modes.artistic_stylization: Permit medium-driven proportion or form stylization when clearly artistic rather than presented as literal anatomy.
